title: Psychology Facts
hook: Nobody is looking at you. Here's the proof.
facts: Cornell students wore an *embarrassing* T-shirt into a room of strangers.
They guessed *half* the room would notice it.
The real number? Only about *a quarter*.
It's called the *spotlight effect*. We think the world is watching us, but it's mostly busy worrying about itself.
outro: So stop worrying. Nobody is looking at you.
